Anya (ML): hey team — thinking out loud about the calibration dataset for the upcoming quant experiments (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). i'd like to avoid calling it 'calib' — proposing we use \"anchor-suite\" to describe the curated strata + seed utterances we carry between experiments.
Miguel: +1 on name, sounds less overloaded. what are the concrete axes for the anchor-suite?
Anya (ML): high level: task-type (QA / summarization / code / instruction / classification), token-length bins (short <32 / mid 32-256 / long >256), rare-entity/slot coverage, numerics/math, multi-turn context, and an adversarial paraphrase subset. also negative-controls (garbage/unrelated) and privacy-aware holdouts.
Sara: can we reuse prod logs for coverage? best practice is stratified sampling from logs + synthetic augmentation for low-frequency cells. also dedupe and strip PII first.
Anya (ML): exactly. sketch of sampling heuristic:

```
1) pull 100k anonymized examples from logs across last 90d
2) bucket by task and length
3) downsample popular templates, upsample rare entities via paraphrasing
4) add 500 adversarial paraphrases per critical task
5) reserve 20% as holdout for final regression checks
```

Miguel: how big should the anchor-suite be? i've seen recommendations all over (2k to 20k). what's reasonable for multi-model bakeoffs?
Anya (ML): target ~8k-12k for routine comparisons. breakdown example: 3k short, 4k mid, 2k long, 1k multi-turn/adversarial. smaller quick checks can use a 1k \"smoke\" anchor.
Kai (Privacy): important: PII scrubbing must be provable. keep an audit trail for examples that were redacted vs generated. recommend a separate flag for \"synth-origin\" so metrics can be filtered.
devops-bot: deploy test-run started for quant-suite v0.1 — job id 3567. logs -> https://ci.internal/jobs/3567 :eyes:
Sara: quick snippet for dedupe + stratified sample (python):

```
from random import sample
# pseudo
groups = data.groupby(['task','length_bin'])
selected = []
for g in groups:
    n = min(len(g), target_per_cell[g.name])
    selected += sample(g.index.tolist(), n)
```

Sara: also add fuzzy-dedup (jaccard/token-set) so paraphrases don't leak duplicates.
Miguel: metrics side — what do we track per anchor-suite cell? suggestions: exact-match (where applicable), rouge/bleu for gen, semantic-similarity (embedding cosine) and calibrated confidence/errors. also compute distributional coverage (token/type counts) vs prod.
Anya (ML): and track per-model delta and an aggregate \"regression score\": weighted sum across task-critical cells. set alert if regression_score > 0.015 for GA models, >0.01 for critical routes. thresholds are tunable.
Miguel: deployment profiles — remind me: we run quant variants under realistic infer shapes (batch=1 latency SLO, batch>1 throughput) and with KV-cache warm/cold?
Anya (ML): yes. we should include three runtime profiles in the anchor-suite runs: 1) latency SLO emulation (short inputs, batch=1, cold KV), 2) throughput (mixed lengths, batch=16, warm KV), 3) long-seq stress (long inputs, memory check). compare accuracy deltas under each.
Kai (Privacy): for private deployments, we may need a different anchor-suite that excludes any ambiguous prod-derived examples — flagging that upfront avoids legal headaches.
Sara: minor ops note: store anchor-suite components as small JSONL shards named by stratum, include provenance tags: {source:prod|synth, anonymized:true, derivation:paraphrase-v2}. keep total size <200MB so CI can fetch quickly.
Anya (ML): thought about adversarial paraphrases: three flavors — meaning-preserving paraphrase, meaning-flip (label changes), and prompt-injection style. include each with explicit labels.
Miguel: how do we ensure variety of instruction style? few-shot examples, terse directives, Q->A, role-play. we should have a checklist for prompt-format variants.
Anya (ML): will draft a checklist and a markdown doc, but quick list here: 1) explicit instruction, 2) conversational, 3) constrained-output (formatting), 4) retrieval-augmented (with fake context), 5) code-block prompts.
Sara: do we want targeted probes for quant artifacts? e.g., numerics where quant can lose precision, or tokenization-edge cases that change logits.
Anya (ML): yes. include numeric edgecases (long decimals, repeated small floats), mixed script inputs, and token-split boundary tests.
Miguel: on evaluation: run paired bootstrap for significance on critical cells so we don't over-interpret small deltas.
Kai (Privacy): add a mandatory privacy review for any anchor-suite refresh that pulls new prod data.
Anya (ML): next steps: i'll push an initial anchor-suite spec doc and a 1k smoke JSONL for the CI job. Sara, can you add the dedupe + provenance tags to the ingestion pipeline?
Sara: yup, i'll PR the pipeline changes today and link the scripts in the spec.
Miguel: i'll hook the regression scoring into the dashboard so we get per-route alerts.
Anya (ML): cool — thanks. will post the spec link when ready. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: job 3567 finished — smoke-run passed on quant family FP8/INT8 (baseline checks). artifacts -> https://ci.internal/artifacts/3567
Miguel: nice. let's iterate on the adversarial bucket next week.
Anya (ML): agree — i'll schedule a short sync.
